Maya R: Morning — dropping an async pulse. Onboarding llama-3-small-q -> prod variant v2. What I did: ran the first-pass evals on promptset 'helpdesk-v2' and saw ~6% drop in answer completeness vs our baseline.

Maya R: Blocker: can't repro the regression locally on my 4x GPU env; failing mostly on hosted/dedicated runs. Need access to dedicated infra logs + model config.

Sam K: Did: pushed a small batching tweak to runtime (adaptive batch cap) and added a short TTL cache (10s) to reduce repeat tokens. Saw throughput +12% on perf tests.

Sam K: Blocker: need the exact model config you used (quant/profile name) to reproduce the numeric diff. Happy to run ablation on dedicated once I have it.

Oliver T: Quick QA glance — the regression cluster is concentrated on creative/judgment prompts (tone + examples). Hypothesis: quantization profile (int8 path) + kernel fallback producing subtle decay. Will try int8-no-kv run.

Jen L: I can review the promptset tonight. Can you drop the top failing examples here? Also we might add a guard for 'tone: step-by-step' vs generic 'help' instructions. :thinking_face:

eval-bot: Automated eval summary — helpdesk-v2 delta: completeness -6.2%, hallucination +1.1%, latency +8ms. Top failing example ids: [12,45,78]. Report: https://evals.internal/reports/1717654321

Maya R: Minimal repro (paste): ```\ninput: "How do I reset my password for Product X?"\nexpected: "Step-by-step, numbered instructions with links and exact nav path"\nactual: "Try checking account settings or contact support"\n```
Model config used: model_variant=llama3-small-q_v2, quant=int8-optimized, batch=4. @Sam K can you schedule a rerun on dedicated-us-west-2? @Oliver T I'm attaching the failing set to the eval report.

Sam K: Scheduled rerun on dedicated-us-west-2 for 11:30 PT. Will post logs + stderr when done.

Oliver T: Kicking off an int8-no-kv job now to test whether KV-cache quant path is implicated. If that passes, kernel selection becomes primary suspect.

Jen L: Also going to experiment with phrasing tweaks — 'step-by-step' vs 'bulleted steps' — and add those variations to the prompt ablation set.

Maya R: Thanks all. If anyone finds a quick root cause, @me. Marking this thread as async-check until noon PT.

Sam K: will update when rerun completes. :thumbsup:

Oliver T: will post int8-no-kv results in this thread.

Jen L: dropping a couple quick prompt edits shortly.
